description:
After making a bet with their husbands to see who can survive longer using only 19th-century technology, Lucy Ricardo (Lucille Ball) and Ethel Mertz (Vivian Vance) attempt to bake bread from scratch. Lucy misreads the recipe and adds far too much yeast - resulting in an oversized loaf that literally explodes out of the oven. Season 1, Episode 25: Pioneer Women
